item.title: Army West Point Broadcasts Lead Patriot League in Viewership
item.description: With the highest ESPN+ viewership in the Patriot League, Army West Point’s 2025–26 broadcasts drew national audiences and spotlighted the unique discipline, leadership, and values of cadet‑athletes.

item.title: West Point Founders Day Celebrations Worldwide
item.description: West Point Societies and graduates around the world are gathering to celebrate Founders Day, honoring the legacy of the United States Military Academy and the values of Duty, Honor, Country. With more than 100 events worldwide, these celebrations strengthen the bonds that connect generations of the Long Gray Line.

item.title: The LT Who Would be SUPT
item.description: While preparing the 2025 Register of Graduates & Former Cadets, a fascinating piece of West Point history emerges: the story of Medal of Honor recipient Albert Leopold Mills, Class of 1879—the only first lieutenant ever appointed Superintendent of the U.S. Military Academy—and the lasting reforms he brought to the Corps.

item.title: West Point Cadets Shine as 70th Brigade Boxing Open Highlights Grit, Skill, and New Champions
item.description: The 70th West Point Brigade Boxing Open highlighted determination and talent as new and returning champions secured titles and prepared for NCBA regionals.

item.title: Forging Leaders: West Point Cadets Tested in Norwegian Foot March
item.description: Over 2,000 West Point cadets completed the 18.6‑mile Norwegian Foot March, pushing through cold, dark terrain to build resilience and leader readiness.

item.title: CDT Larry Pickett '28 Receives Soldier’s Medal
item.description: CDT Larry Pickett '28 receives the Soldier’s Medal at West Point’s Founder’s Day after saving a man from a vehicle fire in a heroic act of selfless service.

item.title: Podcast: An Army Officer’s Mission to Space with COL Anne McClain ’02
item.description: From missile defense to the big screen, LTG (R) Dan Karbler reveals how he helped Oscar-winning director Kathryn Bigelow bring military authenticity to A House of Dynamite. Tune in to this WPAOG Podcast for behind-the-scenes insights on leadership and filmmaking.

item.title: West Point Mountaineering Team Tackles Catskills Terrain During Winter Training
item.description: After the recent snowfall and freezing temperatures, the West Point Mountaineering Team took advantage of the conditions and conducted an ice climbing trip to the Catskill Mountains.

item.title: West Point Gymnastics Captures USAG National Title
item.description: Army West Point gymnastics made program history, capturing its first USAG Collegiate National Team Championship while earning seven All-American honors and an individual national title from Cadet Nick Lester.
